name: Yang Jie
personality: Jovial wanderer who loves alcohol, old tales, long journeys and protecting the weak.
story: A wandering warrior monk who fights and heals with mysterious techniques. He joins automatically on Dietrich's route (as the recruitment tutorial per KeenGamer); on other routes he needs Renown, Support and correct answers to his questions.

personalSkill.name: Monkly Havoc
personalSkill.effect: After defeating a foe, recovers HP equal to max HP (trigger rate Lck/2). Lv20: Robust Health (Shld+3 when attacked); Lv35: Robust Health+ (Shld+5).

why: Joins Dietrich's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Diviner in Ch 5, Priest in Ch 6 (White Magic C), Bishop in Ch 10 at Renown 8 (White Magic B). Train White Magic; first White-Magic Manuals go to him. Keep an axe for Monkly Havoc kills. Master Barrier (Res +3 to adjacent allies), which covers the Dreadnoughts' low Res. Avoid mounted classes. Physic lets him heal from range.

guide.summary: Main healer with an axe for Monkly Havoc kills. Priest in Ch 6 and Bishop in Ch 10, where Physic lets him heal at range and Barrier covers the Dreadnoughts' low Res.
